findings.message: Frozen patch matches the actual candidate and uses the correct recorded main base.
findings.evidence: SHA-256 of evidence/docs-contribution.patch and the candidate git diff both match docs-freeze.json and docs-verification.json. Docs HEAD, main and origin/main all equal 9ccc71c0548ac04becef597c4585a3cad5f9337b, matching docs-admission.json.

findings.message: Wording correctly describes pointer-width preservation, alignment, reservations and both feature flags.
findings.evidence: docs-source/rtos-docs/threadx/modules/ROOT/pages/chapter4.adoc:3648 matches evidence/contribution.patch and source/common/src/tx_thread_create.c:126-150: under TX_ENABLE_STACK_CHECKING, size is rounded down and reduced by sizeof(ULONG), start is aligned upward, and another sizeof(ULONG) is deducted when alignment changes. Both pointer conversions use ALIGN_TYPE without a TX_MISRA_ENABLE split, preserving address width while allowing alignment adjustment. evidence/issue.json identifies the original narrowing defect.

findings.message: Pointer guidance preserves the public API contract and the change remains focused without duplicating docs#79.
findings.evidence: source/common/inc/tx_api.h:1702 and :1739 declare stack_start as VOID *. The candidate adds only one Description paragraph; git diff --check passes. Merged docs#79, commit 47658062ecc05d62d54b24a6733d70405ef80984, is an ancestor of the docs base and changes ULONG type explanations in the two about-this-guide pages; this patch leaves those explanations untouched.

findings.message: Actual candidate HTML render evidence is present and current.
findings.evidence: evidence/documentation/render.log records npm run build:html with the docs-html destination; render.log.json records exit_code 0 from docs-source. evidence/docs-html/threadx/main/chapter4.html:7036 contains the exact added paragraph under tx_thread_create Description with correctly rendered emphasis. HTML modification time follows both candidate source and patch; docs-verification.json identifies this page and the matching frozen digest.

findings.message: Pass establishes suitability for actual human review as unpublished preparation only.
findings.evidence: docs-source/CONTRIBUTING.md:58-67 requires an ECA associated with the commit author email; this review does not establish that match or human provenance review. docs-verification.json explicitly leaves upstream maintainer review unclaimed. Local render and test evidence do not establish upstream CI or maintainer approval.
